title: perf-canary-autodetect-rollout-guards-latency-thresholds
author: Priya Narang
description: Add automated detection and rollout guards to the performance canary pipeline. Motivation: reduce the number of rollouts that accidentally increase 99th percentile latency or reduce throughput for critical routes. This PR implements a detector that compares current canary latency/throughput distributions against the baseline using moving-window percentiles, applies configurable thresholds, and enforces hysteresis to prevent flapping. The detector integrates with the existing canary service and RolloutController to block automated traffic promotions when regressions exceed thresholds. Included changes: config schema for canary thresholds and hysteresis, detector implementation with offline-mode and live-mode, integration with alerting and dashboard links, unit and integration tests, and docs updates. Testing and rollout plan: feature gate enabled by default in staging and off in production; rollout will start with a 10% canary for two hours and auto-promote only if detector reports no regression and observability checks pass. See linked Linear tickets for evaluation criteria and dashboards. Checklist: [x] detector implementation [x] config schema [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] e2e canary validation [x] docs and release notes [x] alert rules and dashboards

review_comments: Marcus Lee: Nicely scoped. Two requests before merge: 1) can you add an integration test that simulates transient blips to validate hysteresis behavior? 2) tighten the default 99p threshold to 15% rather than 20% so we start conservative.
Priya Narang: Thanks Marcus — added transient blip scenario in tests and lowered default 99p threshold to 15% in canary_schema.yaml (see commit 2).
Elena Gomez: Algorithm looks good; please ensure detector evaluation is bounded CPU-wise. Suggest running the detector on a sampled set of traces when throughput is >10k rps.
Priya Narang: Good catch Elena — added sampling and a CPU budget config knob (detector.sample_rate, detector.cpu_budget_percent). Updated docs with guidance.
Samir Khatri: CI failed on first run due to flake in canary_autodetect_test. Re-ran and CI passed. Approving.
Samir Khatri: Approve after CI green.

release_notes: Add automated perf canary detector and rollout guards: configurable latency/throughput thresholds, hysteresis to prevent flapping, sampling controls, and telemetry. Default thresholds conservative (99p latency +15%). Gate-controlled rollout: staging enabled, production opt-in.
notes_for_ops: Ops: monitor canary_detector_evaluations_total and canary_regression_score. Default alert fires when regression_score > 1 for 3 consecutive evaluations. To override thresholds set config values in charts/canary/values.yaml. If rollouts are blocked, RolloutController will emit events on the rollout object and create a ticket in the canary investigation queue.
testing_notes: Unit tests added for comparator and hysteresis logic. Integration tests simulate baseline->regression->recovery windows and validate detector decisions. E2E job runs benchmark script against a local canary cluster to validate no infra-induced regressions.
related_work: See ENG-4123 for evaluation criteria and ENG-4198 for dashboard and alerting work. Related hotfix SUP-8742 addressed an immediate canary blockage during incident and is referenced here to prevent recurrence.
